description: This file defines the API and structures for managing file write-locks used by Git, including functions for creating, managing, and cleaning up lock files which are primarily used for mutual exclusion, atomic updates, and automatic cleanup in version control operations.

classes.name: lock_file
classes.description: Structure representing a lock file, encapsulating a tempfile used for locking mechanisms.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
methods.description: Attempt to create a lockfile for a specified path with options for timeout, flags, and mode.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
methods.description: Attempt to create a lockfile with a specified timeout (default mode: 0666).

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags)
methods.description: Attempt to create a lockfile with default flags and no timeout.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Attempt to create a lockfile with specified mode, no timeout.

methods.name: int is_lock_file_locked(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Check if the lockfile is currently active (locked).

methods.name: unable_to_lock_message
methods.description: Generate an error message when locking fails, appending info to a buffer.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_die
methods.description: Emit error message and terminate program if locking fails.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * mode)
methods.description: Associate a stdio stream with an open lockfile.

methods.name: const char * get_lock_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieve the path of the lockfile.

methods.name: int get_lock_file_fd(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieve the file descriptor of the lockfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_lock_file_fp(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieve the stdio FILE pointer of the lockfile.

methods.name: get_locked_file_path
methods.description: Get the real path of the locked file; caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: int close_lock_file_gently(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Close the lockfile without removing or renaming it, if still open.

methods.name: int reopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Re-open a previously closed lockfile for further operations.

methods.name: commit_lock_file
methods.description: Finalize the lock by closing and renaming to final destination.

methods.name: int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path)
methods.description: Finalize the lock by renaming the temporary lockfile to a specified path.

methods.name: int rollback_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Cancel the lock and remove the lockfile.

ctags.name: commit_lock_file_to
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file *lk, const char *path)$/

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_mode
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
